title: My Girlfriend's Child
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-school couple Sachi and Takara have sex, and Sachi later learns she is pregnant (Seven Seas blurb). The story follows the shock, Sachi weighing her options and the parents' reactions, with one mother supporting the teens' choice and the other demanding they break up (SLJ). Complete in 10 volumes; it won the Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo and an Eisner for teens (MU).
life_message: Teens facing pregnancy deserve honest information, empathy and support to make their own decision.

content.note: Emotional shock and family conflict; a dead cat used as a metaphor (SLJ).
Teen sex is the premise (blurb); 'a brief, non-graphic sex scene' in vol. 1 (SLJ); MU Teen Pregnancy.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Crisis handled by talking and information, not saving face (SLJ).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Teens' own decision prioritized; one mother backs whatever they choose (SLJ).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Volume 2 centers on parents learning the news (SLJ).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Parental authority contested by the teens' agency (SLJ).

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Individual choice and emotional honesty valued (SLJ).

folkways.japan: Family reactions reflect Japanese concern with school reputation and household face around teen pregnancy, which the story depicts rather than endorses.

delivery.evidence: AniList tags it Educational; SLJ says it lays out options and resources for readers, without calling it preachy.
delivery.note: SLJ says the manga 'doesn't vilify any of the options'; the disapproving parent is described as realistic rather than mocked.

winners_losers: Sympathy centers on Sachi and Takara; the parent who demands a breakup is shown as an obstacle but described as realistic. The final decision is not covered by the sources.
